subject: Analytics contract: sizing, seat vs event options, and pricing request
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com
To: emma@amplitude.com, renewals@amplitude.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Sizing & pricing clarification for Amplitude contract renewal

Hi Emma / Renewals team,

We're working through our Amplitude renewal for Q2 and I need a clearer picture on the recommended licensing shape. A few asks so we can get internal approvals lined up:

- Can you confirm our current avg monthly events and 90/95th percentile peak? (We saw a spike in Jan due to the feature launch.)
- Please provide seat counts vs active users over the last 6 months (we're currently at ~20 seats but many inactive users are still billed).
- Send the proposal with both an event-committed tier and a seat-based option so we can compare unit economics.
- Any standard discounts for multi-year or committed event volume? We typically push for 10% on renewals.
- Please include a DocuSign link and a CSV of raw usage by product area if available.

We'd like to finalize by end of March. Looping in Karthik (product) for technical sizing.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com

From: Emma Zhang <emma@amplitude.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com
Cc: renewals@amplitude.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sizing & pricing clarification for Amplitude contract renewal

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a proposal and a usage export to help compare options (see attachment stubs below). High level summary based on your account:

- Current avg events: 520M events/month (4-week rolling average); 95th percentile monthly peak: ~760M events.
- Active seats: 18 in last 90 days, 22 seats on the license (we can remove unused seats).

Options we recommend:
1) Event-committed tier (recommended for your usage profile):
   - Commit: 600M events/month, $0.0022 per event beyond committed (tiered overage), 12-month term.
   - Included retention: 6 months; additional retention tiers available.
2) Seat-based (simpler for orgs tracking users):
   - 22 seats at $125/seat/month, usage overages billed separately for events beyond 300M included baseline.

Discounting: Standard new-commit discount is 8% for 12-month, 12% for 24-months on committed event spend. We can consider the 10% you mentioned if you move to a 24-month committed band or add a platform integration bundle.

Attachments (stubs):
- Amplitude_Proposal_Redwood_v2.pdf (proposal with pricing tables)
- Redwood_Usage_Q1_2026.csv (per-product event breakdown, sanitized)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/amp-proposal-REDWOOD-v2

If it helps, I can carve out a short call with our sales engineer to walk through per-product ingestion and retention sizing.

Best,
Emma Zhang
Enterprise Renewals Lead, Amplitude
emma@amplitude.com

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com, laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:54:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Sizing & pricing clarification for Amplitude contract renewal

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Emma's reply + attachments. Key points: 520M avg / 760M peak, recommended 600M committed event tier vs 22 seats. They have a DocuSign link and suggested discount tiers.

Questions for Product/Finance:
- Karthik: can you confirm whether 600M committed events maps to our retention requirements (we need 6 months for user-level historical lookups for feature attribution)? Also need per-product breakdown for query load (not just ingestion).
- Laura: any visibility on budget timing and whether we can push for a 10% concession if we sign a 24-month term? Finance typically needs a deal ID and committed spend to evaluate.

I think we should push back on retention (we currently retain 12 months in our analytics flows), so ask if Amplitude will include a retention add-on at a lower incremental price. Also worth negotiating seat cleanup to avoid paying for inactive seats.

Next step: propose a 30-minute sync Mon/Tue next week with Amplitude + our product/finance. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Thanks for the forward — quick notes from product: 

- 600M/month committed looks reasonable on ingestion, but it does not account for query volumes during heavy experimentation days. We should get the per-product ingestion + query QPS for the last 90 days from Amplitude; the CSV may be ingestion-only.
- For retention: we need 12 months of user-level retention for attribution and long-tail cohort analysis. If Amplitude's base includes only 6 months, ask for a discounted retention add-on (or keep archival in S3 path).
- Seats: we can reduce to 16 active seats and use SSO auto-provisioning audits to keep it clean. That should reduce seat-costs on the seat-based option.

Negotiation asks to return to Amplitude: 
- Revised proposal with 24-month committed event tier at a 10% effective discount, and inclusion of 12-month retention (or a priced add-on with preferred discount).
- Per-product event + query breakdown for last 90 days (ingestion + query QPS) to correctly size commit and expected overage.
- Ask for a 60-day SLA on ingestion/processing for enterprise accounts (we've had two incidents impacting dashboards).

Also agree on a short meeting — I can join Monday 2/23 11:00-11:30 PT. Vanessa — can you propose the slot?

—Karthik
Director, Product

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com

Hi Emma / Renewals team — thanks for the proposal. Following internal review, we have three asks before we can move to procurement:

1) Pricing revision: please provide a revised 24-month committed events proposal with a 10% effective discount on committed event spend (we're open to slightly higher commit if needed). Include explicit per-month committed dollars so we can enter into the budget.

2) Usage detail: provide a 30-day lookback CSV with per-product event ingestion and query metrics (QPS) so Product can size query load. The Redwood_Usage_Q1_2026.csv was helpful but we need the recent 30-day slice.

3) Retention & SLA: either include 12-month retention in the committed package or provide a priced add-on with preferential discount. Also document any ingestion/processing SLAs for enterprise accounts (we request a 60-day incident response window and escalation path).

If you can send an updated proposal and DocuSign link by EOD Friday (2/27), we can schedule Procurement to review the committed spend and move to signature. We're available to meet Mon 2/23 11:00-11:30 PT if you can do that slot (Karthik will join).

Thanks — please attach the revised proposal and the 30-day CSV to your reply.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
